title: The 90-Day Reporting Cost Calculator
subtitle: Convert weekly manual reporting hours into annualized labor cost and churn risk exposure in under 5 minutes.

inputs.label: Active client accounts requiring weekly reports
inputs.hint: Count every account that gets a recurring reporting deliverable.

inputs.label: Average hours per report, per account, per week
inputs.hint: Include data pulling, formatting, QA, and last-mile tweaks.

inputs.label: Fully-loaded hourly cost of the person doing reporting
inputs.hint: Salary plus benefits plus overhead divided by 2,000.

inputs.label: Percent of reports that arrive late or get skipped monthly
inputs.hint: Be honest. Most agencies land between 15 and 30 percent.

inputs.label: Average monthly revenue per account
inputs.hint: Your typical retainer or recurring fee.

inputs.label: Average client tenure in months
inputs.hint: How long a typical account stays before churning.

inputs.label: Churn lift when reporting is inconsistent
inputs.hint: Default 18 percent based on service-firm churn audits.

inputs.label: Target reporting time per account after automation
inputs.hint: Most automated flows land between 0.25 and 0.75 hours per account.

recommendations.text: Your manual reporting is the cost equivalent of a full-time hire that never made it to the org chart. Automating this is no longer optional, it is a margin recovery project.
Your churn risk exposure is large enough that one or two preventable losses this year will eclipse any reporting tooling investment by 10x or more.
More than 1 in 4 reports slipping is a renewal conversation problem, not a capacity problem. Clients quietly downgrade trust long before they churn.
You have scale but your per-report time is already lean. The use here is consistency and on-time delivery, not raw hour reduction.
The gap between your current and target time is exactly the sweet spot n8n plus Claude workflows close in 30 to 60 days. This is the highest ROI automation in your stack.
Long tenure plus mid-to-high retainers means every prevented churn is worth six figures over the life of the account. Reporting reliability compounds here.

capture_cta.headline: See your 90-day automation roadmap
capture_cta.description: Get a tailored breakdown of how to cut your reporting time from hours to minutes per account, with the exact workflow architecture used by agencies in the $1M to $20M range.
